papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.short_title: Attention replaces recurrence for sequence transduction
papers.one_liner: Transformer uses attention for sequence transduction.
papers.summary_cn: The Transformer replaces recurrent and convolutional components with attention. The abstract reports translation quality and training-efficiency gains on two translation tasks, plus an application to constituency parsing. This reading note is based on the abstract; it does not verify the experiments or code.
papers.evidence: The abstract reports 28.4 BLEU for English-to-German translation.
papers.limitations: Verify comparable training budgets and isolate the contribution of individual design choices.
papers.insight_for_us: Useful for readers studying sequence modeling and attention.
papers.reading_reason: Inspect the method and experimental controls before drawing efficiency conclusions.
